content: Competitor X raised its Pro plan from $79 to $89 per seat per month in Q2 2026, citing expanded audit controls.
Competitor X plans to hire twelve enterprise account executives in North America during the second half of 2026.
Competitor Y introduced annual-only pricing with a 15 percent discount for teams of more than fifty users.
The platform deploy cadence is weekly: production releases are prepared on Mondays and released every Tuesday.
The approved production deploy window is Tuesday from 14:00 to 16:00 UTC, with product and support on standby.
For a failed release, use the deployment dashboard rollback control, notify #incident-ops, and record the rollback reason in the incident timeline.
Customer workspace content is retained for 30 days after deletion is requested, then is permanently purged from active systems.
Workspace data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit; encryption keys are managed by the cloud KMS.
Incident INC-482 was caused by an expired cache credential after key rotation; the mitigation added credential refresh monitoring.
Administrator accounts require phishing-resistant MFA through passkeys or hardware security keys; SMS is not an accepted administrator factor.
The standard support plan has a one-business-day first-response SLA, while the Enterprise plan has a four-hour first-response SLA.
A P1 support escalation pages the on-call engineer immediately and requires an incident commander within fifteen minutes.
Acme Health renewed its Enterprise agreement through December 2027 and requested a quarterly security review.
Northstar Retail asked for SAML group-to-role mapping before its planned October rollout.
The mobile roadmap prioritizes offline note capture and background synchronization for the September release.
CSV export scheduling is planned for the Q4 product cycle after the access-control redesign is complete.
Invoices are emailed to workspace billing contacts on the first calendar day of each month and are also available in Billing history.
Refund requests within fourteen days of a new annual subscription may be approved if no more than twenty percent of included usage has been consumed.
The backend engineering opening is a senior Python role focused on retrieval reliability and is approved for remote work in the EU time zones.
The product design opening is hybrid in Ho Chi Minh City and focuses on enterprise workflow research.
The research team found that source-linked AI summaries reduce analyst review time when citations remain visible beside each claim.
The privacy research initiative is evaluating differential privacy for aggregate usage reporting before any customer data is shared externally.
The passport is stored in the locked desk drawer beneath the monitor, inside a blue document envelope.
The cat's annual veterinary appointment is scheduled for 10:30 on 14 September at Riverbank Veterinary Clinic.
The public API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per workspace, with Retry-After returned when the limit is exceeded.
Webhook deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256; clients must verify the X-Nowing-Signature header using the workspace webhook secret.
Weekly activation is defined as a new workspace that creates a project, invites one collaborator, and completes its first search within seven days.
Monthly churn counts paid workspaces that cancel or fail payment and do not reactivate by the end of the following billing cycle.
The status page is hosted by StatusBeacon; its public incident URL is maintained in the customer support runbook.
The observability vendor is SignalWatch, which provides traces, metrics, and the primary on-call alert routing integration.
The standard data-processing agreement is available through the legal portal and requires a counterparty name plus workspace legal entity before signature.
Legal hold suspends routine deletion for named records until counsel releases the hold, even when the normal retention period has elapsed.
The remote-work policy supports employees working from their approved country for up to ninety days per calendar year after manager confirmation.
The engineering offsite is scheduled for 6-8 November in Da Nang, with travel booked by the Operations team.
The June security drill showed that the alert escalation completed in six minutes; the follow-up action is to document an after-hours customer notification template.
Production database backups run every six hours, are encrypted, and are retained for thirty-five days with a quarterly restore test.
